verdict.rationale: Qdrant's security docs describe three API key types: Admin, Read-Only for query-only consumers, and Granular Access API Keys with per-collection read/write scoping. Together these let a user give an agent least-privilege credentials limited to specific collections and operations. Missing for 10: details on how scoped keys are issued (generation mechanics, expiry, revocation), agent-specific guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the scoping works as documented.
